name: Board
description: A .k5board file in a K2 tab: an infinite whiteboard you and your agents build together, saved in the file.

reasons.store:read: to load this board file, and see changes as you and your agents make them
reasons.store:write: to save your changes in this board file
reasons.links:open: to open a link on the board in your browser when you click Open
reasons.downloads:save: to save a picture of this board to your Downloads
reasons.uploads:pick: to add pictures to this board from your files
